p3_b4.ocr: In 2022, the defect rate further decreased to 1.5%, achieving total revenue of $120M and net income of $18M, with CAPEX at $18M. The trend continued into 2023 with a defect rate of 1.2%, total revenue of $130M, and net income of $20M, along with CAPEX at $20M, culminating in 2024 with the lowest defect rate of 1.0%, total revenue of $140M, and net income of $22M, while CAPEX reached $22M. p3_b5.ocr: In 2020, savings increased to 18%, with 1600 units sold, $1.8M in downtime reduction, a headcount of $450K, 96% machine utilization, maintenance costs of $950K, and total revenue of $22M. In 2022, savings reached 25%, monitoring 1800 units, with $1.2M in downtime reduction, headcount of $350K, 98% machine utilization, maintenance costs of $850K, and total revenue of $26M.
